title: HeMAiA Memory-Chip HBM
description: The simulated HBM of one memory chip (hw/hemaia/hemaia_mem_system/hbm), declared as the `hbm` object of a hemaia_mem_chip entry; a memory chip without one has no HBM. occamygen renders the object into the testharness as hemaia_hbm_pkg::hbm_cfg_t and exports base and size of the first memory chip's HBM to SW as HBM_BASE_ADDR / HBM_SIZE. The defaults are HBM2e as an AMD FPGA exposes it (two stacks of 16 pseudo-channels at 25.6 GB/s, 16 GiB), with latency calibrated to a measured FPGA HBM (Shuhai, FCCM 2020: 106.7 / 122.2 / 137.8 ns row hit / closed / conflict; the model gives 106.5 / 120.5 / 134.5 ns). All times are picoseconds of simulated time, independent of the memory-chip clock.

base.description: Chip-local base address. The memory chip's wide xbar sends 0x1_0000_0000 and up to the DRAM port, so the HBM cannot start lower; base + size must not exceed the 40-bit chip-local space (1 TiB). Defaults to 0x1_0000_0000.

size.description: Capacity in bytes; a multiple of the 64-byte bus width. Defaults to 16 GiB.

num_channels.description: Pseudo-channels: independent command and data buses that serve accesses in parallel.

num_banks.description: Banks per pseudo-channel, each with its own open row.

row_bytes.description: Row (page) size of one pseudo-channel in bytes.

interleave_bytes.description: Consecutive bytes mapped to one pseudo-channel before the next. 4096 keeps every AXI burst (which never crosses 4 KiB) on one channel. 0 gives each channel one contiguous size / num_channels range.

channel_mbps.description: Peak data rate of one pseudo-channel in MB/s; sets how long one bus beat occupies its channel.

t_ctrl_ps.description: Controller + PHY + fabric latency, request and response path together: the part of every access that is not DRAM. Half is charged before the command, half after the data.

t_cwl_ps.description: Column write to data (CAS write latency).

t_rcd_ps.description: Activate to column command: paid by an access to a closed row.

t_rp_ps.description: Precharge: paid, on top of t_rcd_ps, by an access to a bank holding another row open.

t_refi_ps.description: Refresh interval per pseudo-channel, staggered across channels. 0 disables refresh.

t_rfc_ps.description: Refresh duration: the channel is blocked and its rows are closed afterwards.

max_reads.description: Read bursts in flight before the model back-pressures AR.

max_writes.description: Write bursts in flight before the model back-pressures AW.
